profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II | AI Systems, Model Evaluation & Agentic AI
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software engineer passionate about building AI systems that genuinely benefit humanity. Over the past 4+ years at Khan Academy, I've been at the forefront of developing and evaluating AI-powered educational tools that serve millions of learners worldwide.


My AI systems experience includes:

• Model Evaluation & Safety: Built comprehensive evaluation frameworks for testing AI model performance across multiple frontier models (GPT-4o, Gemini, Phi3, o3-mini). Developed systems that improved AI safety moderation accuracy from ~60% to 80%+ using machine learning optimization techniques.


• Production Agentic Systems: Co-designed Khanmigo's agentic architecture from inception, creating structured prompt orchestration, persistent memory systems, and specialized sub-agent components for domain-specific evaluation and tutoring plan generation. Built state management and tool coordination serving millions of students.


• Large-Scale AI Infrastructure: Led migration of conversation storage systems to support extensible AI interactions. Architected A/B testing frameworks for agentic behavior optimization, successfully launching multiple experimental capabilities to production.


• Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborated across research, product, and engineering teams to translate complex AI research into scalable, user-friendly systems. Advocated for empirical, iterative approaches that prioritize measurable impact over technical complexity.


I believe AI should augment human capabilities while remaining safe, interpretable, and aligned with human values. My experience spans the full spectrum from rapid prototyping (hackathon to production in 2 weeks) to long-term infrastructure projects that enable sustainable AI development.


Technical foundation: Full-stack development with expertise in backend systems, data infrastructure, and modern web technologies. Recent focus on AI model evaluation, experimentation frameworks, and production ML systems.


I'm excited about opportunities to contribute to AI safety research and the development of beneficial AI systems that can help solve humanity's biggest challenges.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Advanced AI Systems & Model Evaluation Leadership

• **Led comprehensive model evaluation initiatives** for educational AI systems, building frameworks to test frontier models (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5, Phi3, o3-mini) and optimize AI tutoring performance across diverse learning scenarios

• **Architected Evaluation-Driven Development practices** establishing measurable approaches for AI system improvements, creating accountability frameworks that moved team decisions from intuition-based to data-driven methodologies

• **Built AI safety and moderation systems** using machine learning optimization (genetic algorithms, neural networks, decision trees) to improve content moderation accuracy from ~60% to 80%+ when compared to human evaluators

• **Developed advanced agentic system components** including specialized sub-agent evaluation systems for automated math problem assessment that analyze student work and generate targeted tutoring recommendations

• **Led cross-functional AI research translation** collaborating with product managers, designers, researchers, and data scientists to implement cutting-edge AI research into production-ready educational tools

**Production Agentic Systems Architecture**

• **Designed and implemented large-scale system migrations** including conversation storage architecture redesign to support extensible AI interactions and improved data accessibility for cross-functional teams

• **Built sophisticated A/B testing frameworks for agentic behavior optimization** implementing experimental capabilities like proactive AI tutoring interventions and dynamic response generation systems
positions.insights: AI Solutions, Large Language Models (LLM) and +2 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Foundational AI Systems Development

• **Co-architected Khanmigo's agentic system architecture** from early prototyping through production launch, creating structured prompt orchestration, activity-specific AI behaviors, and tool coordination frameworks serving millions of students globally

• **Developed production agentic infrastructure** including the "Insights" system - a pluggable analytics framework that processes every AI conversation thread to extract learner interests, enable contextual personalization, and maintain persistent memory across interactions

• **Built core AI engagement systems** architecting proactive tutoring interventions and dynamic response suggestions that successfully launched from experimental features to permanent production capabilities

• **Established rapid agentic prototyping processes** including hackathon-to-production development of AI personalization features delivered in under 2 weeks with cross-functional team coordination

**Infrastructure & Integration Leadership**

• **Drove search system integration** completing AWS CloudSearch implementation across web and mobile platforms, with specialized focus on internationalization for non-English locales


• **Led foundational system architecture** for scalable AI conversation management and cross-platform feature parity


• **Mentored engineering practices** advocating for iterative, north-star approaches that break complex multi-month projects into deliverable increments with measurable impact

projects.title: CMS - Provider Data Catalog
projects.description: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Launched in September of 2020, a new DKAN v2 based, Open Data Catalog to host a wide range of datasets related to CMS service providers. By using DKAN and collaborating with its maintainers, CMS has leveraged Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) to create better user experiences tailored to the needs of the data users and managers.
